# CANDIDATE: CHART_STOP_BUFFER_TIGHTEN_0.25

**Filed:** 2026-09-07  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Tightening the chart stop buffer from $0.50 to $0.25 will reduce premature stop-outs on bearish rejection rides, allowing more of the ribbon-run to be captured on marginal winner days (4/29 and 5/01) without increasing losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

Change the `chart_stop_buffer_dollars` parameter in the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON exit logic from 0.50 to 0.25. The chart stop is triggered when SPY closes a 3-min candle above the rejected level + buffer. A smaller buffer gives the trade more room to breathe before invalidation, while still protecting against a clear break of the rejection level.
